what: Draws the number in the middle of a black panel by adding (lighter) three red·green·blue layers. It jumps 1% at 0ms, 5% at 1000, 12% at 1350, 66% at 1800, 99% at 2200, and each jump tears the screen horizontally in line (2px) units, spreading the three layers by 10% of font size × intensity (glitch intensity falls over .5s as (1−r)², each line wobbles with sin(15y+20t)·sin(73y−10t), a random 15% of lines out of 20 bands are pushed 45% more, updating at 30fps). If ready at 2.6 seconds it hits 100%, and .42 seconds later fades over .5 seconds with glitch scaled up 2.4x as 1−n², then .08 seconds later the panel drops away and fires fx:loaded. If not ready, it waits, glitching at .6 intensity every 1.2 seconds

options.scale: Number multiplier for total time — 1 is the original (2.6s), .3 is .78s. 0 jumps straight to 100%
options.wait: Ready signal event name — if given, holds 100% until that event arrives on document (the original waits until the scene shaders are all set up)
options.out: End glitch and blur duration (s), default .5
options.every: If present, every time it opens (not just once)

use: — When finished, “fx:loaded” fires on document. Text color is --kf-contrast-ink, panel is --kf-contrast-bg

from.where: shared.js runLoader .qd-loader (original loader: steps [1,5,12,66,99] · at [0,1000,1350,1800,2200] · pulse .5s (1−r)² · end 2.4x .5s)
